Classify activity counts using intensity thresholds

Source: R/acti_threshold_counts.R
acti_threshold_counts.Rd

Applies count thresholds to a count-data set after verifying that its timestamps have the requested, regular epoch. Thresholds must be expressed in counts per epoch seconds. Published cut-points should only be used at the epoch and placement for which they were developed.

Usage

acti_threshold_counts(
  data,
  thresholds,
  labels,
  name = "activity_intensity",
  epoch = 60
)

Arguments

data

A data frame with time and counts columns.

thresholds

Increasing numeric lower bounds for successive intensity categories, expressed in counts per epoch seconds.

labels

Labels for the categories. There must be one more label than threshold.

name

Name of the factor column to add to data.

epoch

Required epoch, in seconds.

Value

data with an ordered factor column named by name.

Examples

counts <- data.frame(
  time = as.POSIXct("2020-01-01", tz = "UTC") + 60 * 0:2,
  counts = c(0, 3000, 5000)
)
acti_threshold_counts(
  counts,
  thresholds = c(2860, 3941),
  labels = c("sedentary", "light", "mvpa")
)
#>                  time counts activity_intensity
#> 1 2020-01-01 00:00:00      0          sedentary
#> 2 2020-01-01 00:01:00   3000              light
#> 3 2020-01-01 00:02:00   5000               mvpa
